summary: Frontend-only validation of DirectProjectCreation (/direct-projects) for 4 requirements: (1) Sede dropdown removed from UI, (2) Pinpad sponsor Procesador->Banco sub-modal mirrors 'Banco Patrocinante' logic, (3) Integrator with 1 app auto-fills and locks Application, (4) Integrator with 2+ apps shows mandatory Application drop-list with only that integrator's apps. ALL 4 CHECKS PASS. Non-destructive run: no project was submitted/created.

issues: Radix DialogContent emits warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined}'. Add a DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) for accessibility. Not blocking.

issues: React hydration error: <span data-ve-dynamic> wrapping <tr> inside <tbody>. Not caused by these changes but still present in console.

test_results.TEST1_sede_removed: PASS - [data-testid='dp-sede'] not found in DOM; zero <label>Sede</label> matches; confirmed both before and after rendering all form sections (client/quote-type selected -> Hardware + Integrator sections rendered).
test_results.TEST2_pinpad_processor_modal: PASS - dp-pinpad-bank shows 'Platco · Procesador' option; selecting Platco opens dp-pinpad-processor-link-modal listing exactly 2 linked banks ('Banco Mercantil', 'BBVA Provincial') via dp-pinpad-processor-linked-bank-*. Clicking Banco Mercantil closes the modal and renders dp-pinpad-composite = 'Patrocinador: Platco — Banco Mercantil'. Re-opening dp-pinpad-bank and selecting a non-Procesador bank ('Banco de Venezuela') assigns directly without opening any modal.
test_results.TEST3_integrator_1app_auto_locked: PASS - dp-integrator selecting 'Equinoccio Agency' auto-fills Application; only dp-integrator-app-locked is rendered (text='Odoo Versión 16'); dp-integrator-app Select is NOT rendered. Label counter shows '(1)'.
test_results.TEST4_integrator_2apps_mandatory_select: PASS - dp-integrator selecting 'Epic Tecnology C.A.' renders dp-integrator-app Select (locked div NOT rendered). Label counter '(2)'. Dropdown contains exactly 2 apps: 'Odoo Versión 16', 'YOY en Odoo v16'.

critical_code_review_comments: DialogContent inside dp-pinpad-processor-link-modal is missing DialogDescription / aria-describedby (Radix warning). Add an sr-only DialogDescription for a11y compliance.

DirectProjectCreation.jsx is now 1211 lines. Consider extracting BoxesGrid, HardwareSection, IntegratorPicker and the PinpadProcessorModal into separate files; current file size hurts maintainability.

appsForIntegrator/onValueChange of dp-integrator filters apps by ((i.app_name || '').trim()) which is correct, but logically 'apps.length === 1' auto-set should also write integrator_id (it does). However, when apps.length === 0 (integrator with no apps) the locked div displays 'Sin apps registradas' but allows submit; consider blocking submit when REQUIRES_HW and no app is set.

Linked-bank button label currently renders the bank name concatenated with its type pill text (text_content returned 'Banco MercantilBanco' / 'BBVA ProvincialBanco'). Visually fine due to layout, but consider adding a space/whitespace between name and type tag for cleaner screen-reader output.
